lines.text: Solomon finished the work on the LORD's house and placed David's dedicated silver, gold, and furnishings in the treasuries.
Solomon gathered the elders to bring up the ark, and Israel's men came at the feast in the fifth month.
The Levites took up the ark, and Solomon and the congregation sacrificed sheep and oxen too many to count.
The priests set the ark in the Most Holy Place, holding only the two tablets Aaron placed there.
Singers and trumpeters praised the LORD with one voice, and a cloud filled the temple so priests could not minister.
